 Oreo Just Dropped A New Gingerbread (But Only For A Limited Time)
 By Peter Akpejeluh | October 13, 2026 | Leave A Comment 
 Credit: Liv Averett / Oreo 
 Copy this link to share with your friends!
 https://sporked.com/article/oreo-just-dropped-a-new-gingerbread-but-only-for-a-limited-time/ 
 An Oreo gingerbread treat? Yes, please! Oreo is getting into the holiday spirit with a new seasonal snack called Cakesters Gingerbread and it sounds delicious. The new treat is already showing up at CVS, with more stores expected to get it soon.
 Videos by Sporked 
 These treats could be perfect for a quick snack at work, something to munch on during a road trip, or a little something sweet to share with friends and family. But the Gingerbread Cakesters are only available for a limited time, so you don’t want to wait too long to track them down.
 Oreo Gingerbread Cakesters Are Here 
 If you can’t wait until the holiday snack shelves are packed with everything gingerbread, Oreo Gingerbread Cakesters are already available at CVS, giving you an early chance to try the new release.
 Those who don’t have a CVS nearby won’t have to wait much longer. The product is expected to reach Albertsons, Kroger, Publix, and other retailers starting October 19th.
 It’s already available at Sobeys in Canada, so our friends over there are not missing out. Each box comes with five 2.02 oz packs with two Cakesters in each pack.
 Gingerbread Cakesters are only available for a limited time, so there’s no need to save the treats for a special occasion. Cakesters could work as a quick afternoon snack, something sweet to pack for lunch, or an easy addition to a holiday dessert spread.
 Soft And Fluffy
 Anyone expecting Gingerbread Cakesters to crunch like a regular Oreo cookie should prepare for something different.
 Your regular Oreo cookies have crisp chocolate wafers with creme filling in the middle. Cakesters switch things up with soft, cake-like layers and a creamy center. 
 Oreo already has several Cakesters varieties, including Original, Golden, Double Chocolate, and Confetti Cake. Gingerbread adds a holiday-inspired option to the mix, giving fans another reason to check out the brand’s softer snacks.
 But will the gingerbread flavor actually stand out? That’s for you to find out. Fans are saying the Gingerbread Cakester is super soft and fluffy with a really sweet gingerbread flavor.
 Only For A Limited Time 
 If you’re hoping to make Gingerbread Cakesters a regular part of your snack stash, you’d be disappointed to know they’re only available for a limited time. For now, we don’t know went they will disappear from shelves. 
 CVS shoppers can find the Gingerbread Cakesters right now, while Albertsons, Kroger, Publix, and other retailers are expected to have them on October 19th.
